activities_budget.sourceTitle: Top 10 Attractions in Barcelona [2026] - Book Now on Trip.com
activities_budget.evidenceText: Trip.com exposed Barcelona attraction listings including Sagrada Familia Admission Ticket Without Tower Access (From US$77.37), Sagrada Familia Fast Track Ticket (From US$39.16), and other attraction products. The displayed prices were explicitly From prices and the result did not provide a qualifying non-from adult ticket or tax treatment.
activities_budget.referencePeriod: Trip.com attraction result crawled 4 months before 2026-08-01; package date and tax treatment not stated
activities_budget.searchQuery: site:trip.com/things-to-do Barcelona Spain attraction ticket adult price
activities_budget.reason: Exact-city attraction products were available, but every numeric candidate was a lowest/from price and no non-from adult-ticket price with usable tax status was shown. The strict budget-ticket definition therefore fails closed.

activities_mid_range.sourceTitle: Barcelona Half-Day Tour: La Pedrera – Casa Milà + Casa Vicens + Casa Batlló|Includes admission ticket + guide | Trip.com
activities_mid_range.evidenceText: Barcelona Half-Day Tour: La Pedrera – Casa Milà + Casa Vicens + Casa Batlló is labelled Duration: 3h 5m, Join-in tour, and From US$145.20 per person. The explicit From price is not an eligible non-from price; the source does not state tax treatment.
activities_mid_range.referencePeriod: Trip.com product result crawled 2 months before 2026-08-01; package date and tax treatment not stated
activities_mid_range.searchQuery: site:trip.com/things-to-do Barcelona Spain half day group tour adult price duration
activities_mid_range.reason: The exact-city join-in half-day activity meets the group/duration concept, but its only numeric price is explicitly From and tax status is unknown. No non-from compatible observation is retained.

activities_high_end.sourceTitle: Top Barcelona Day Tours [2026], Deals and Discounts | Trip.com
activities_high_end.evidenceText: TOUR COSTA BRAVA WITH BOAT TRIP is listed for Barcelona with Duration: 9 hrs and From US$64.80. The result does not establish a premium/private basis and the displayed price is explicitly From, so it cannot be retained as the frozen full-day premium measure.
activities_high_end.referencePeriod: Trip.com day-tour result published 5 days before 2026-08-01; booking date and tax treatment not stated
activities_high_end.searchQuery: site:trip.com/things-to-do Barcelona Spain full day premium tour adult price duration
activities_high_end.reason: A 9-hour exact-city tour was visible, but no candidate jointly supplied explicit premium/private status, a non-from per-person adult price, and tax treatment. The high-end definition fails closed.
